body_text: Our admission journey is simple and personal. Fill in the enquiry form online to schedule a personalised school tour, where you can explore our learning environments, meet our educators and experience our play-based, experiential approach first-hand.

items.title: 1. Send an Enquiry
items.text: Fill in the enquiry form online.

items.title: 2. Connect With Our Team
items.text: We call you to schedule a personalised school tour.

items.title: 3. Visit Us
items.text: Explore our spaces, meet our educators and see play-based learning first-hand.

items.title: 4. Next Step
items.text: We guide you through the admission process.
